# dctx

> The context engine for AI-assisted software development. Fewer tokens. Stable prefixes. Exact source. One policy for every workflow.

dctx 1.1.0: a Rust CLI and MCP server; Apache-2.0; offline, no telemetry. Short: https://www.dctx.internet.technology/llms-small.txt

- [README](https://www.dctx.internet.technology/docs/readme/index.md): install, quick start, map mode

- [Map mode](https://www.dctx.internet.technology/docs/map-mode/index.md): every map verb
- [Agent snippet](https://www.dctx.internet.technology/docs/agents/index.md): AGENTS.md text
- [All documents](https://www.dctx.internet.technology/docs/): with Markdown twins
